assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and transient neurological deficits consistent with a history of transient ischemic attacks and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias that may be contributing to these ischemic events.
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I48.0, and Z86.73.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The claim was denied by Federal Medicare (sim).
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
Coverage determinations are strictly governed by the specific terms of the active policy, and this procedure falls outside those parameters.
The patient has the right to appeal this decision.
An appeal requires a written request detailing the medical necessity and any supporting documentation within the timeframe specified in the plan's evidence of coverage.
Failure to submit timely appeals may result in the forfeiture of the right to contest this determination.
